name: Release
description: Structured release process. Pre-flight checks, version tagging, deployment, verification, and announcement. Includes an approval gate after pre-flight to ensure human sign-off before deploying.
narrative: A release is deliberate and gated. Run the pre-flight first — the full test suite and whatever readiness checks the target needs — and then stop for a human's sign-off, because a release is hard to take back. Only after approval do you tag the version, deploy by the project's standard method, and then verify the deployed thing actually works before calling it done. Finish by announcing what shipped: the version, the key changes, and anything operators need to know. The approval gate between pre-flight and deploy is the load-bearing part — never skip it.
